subject: Late-stage runway quantification: request to place soft capacity hold for StratusAI
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Late-stage runway quantification: request to place soft capacity hold for StratusAI

Team —

Quick context: StratusAI is at legal + procurement, PO expected within the next week but they asked for a short reservation window so they don't lose placement in our us-west pool. They will run two models in production: a 13B fine-tuned chat & a 70B retrieval-augmented generator. Anticipated steady-state: ~350 qps for the 13B across batching and ~40 qps for the 70B (spikes to 120 qps during morning batch jobs).

Ask: can we confirm whether we can place a 14-day soft hold starting 2027-09-01 for approximately 12 A100-80GB-equivalent slots in us-west? If we can’t guarantee exact A100 hardware, what’s the closest equivalency we can route to (A40/A10s, etc.) and what are the fallback latency delta expectations?

Operational notes that matter for sizing:
- Model memory: 13B ~ 28GB (FP16), 70B ~ 64–72GB (FP16).
- We prefer 80GB-class nodes for the 70B. Quantization (4-bit) for the 70B is an option if inventory is constrained; request guidance on perf/cost trade-off.
- Start date is flexible by up to 7 days but they want an explicit soft hold to keep deal momentum.

I attached the current scope doc Stratus shared. Please reply with:
1) current available node mix in us-west for Sept 1–30 (thermal bins / cross-availability),
2) recommendation for the soft hold (count, window, buffer percent),
3) any ask we should surface to sales/legal on SLAs or fallback routing.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

Attachment: stratusai_scope_v2.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Late-stage runway quantification: request to place soft capacity hold for StratusAI

On Tue, Aug 24, 2027 at 9:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> Quick context: StratusAI is at legal + procurement...

Jordan / team —

Quick inventory snapshot for us-west (as of 2027-08-24 08:45 PDT):
- A100-80GB (perf bin): 8 nodes free in us-west2 (low thermal), 6 nodes pre-committed but re-routeable after 48h notice.
- A40 / A10 equivalents (multi-GPU or 48GB slices): capacity to host 6 additional 80GB-equivalent workloads with modest perf delta (~+12–18ms p50 for the 70B).
- Additional on-demand capacity in us-east that could be warmed in 24–36h if we do cross-region fallback.

Recommendation:
1) Soft hold: place a 14-day soft hold for 12 slots in us-west2 starting 2027-09-01 with a 20% buffer (hold 15 slots nominal) — buffer covers thermal-binned spares and batch spikes.
2) Fallback routing: primary us-west2 (A100-80GB); fallback pool = mix of A40 slices + A100 preemptible in us-east (route by policy). Document expected p50 latency delta in the runbook; Ops can precompute token-level cost delta.
3) Quantization: 4-bit (QLoRA-like) for the 70B will reduce memory by ~40% and could allow placement on 48GB slices with ~5–7% drop in quality for their generator workload; recommend we offer this as a secondary option only after cost/quality signoff from the customer.

Operational asks for Sales/Legal:
- We should request a firm start date earliest by PO signature + 7 days so we can transition pre-committed nodes.
- Need approval for temporary buffer cost (we may bill a soft-hold reservation fee or convert to committed capacity).

I ran a quick export — attaching the capacity snapshot. I’ll open a short-runbook (ops link below) for the hold and can push the soft hold into the scheduler after we get leadership sign-off on buffer billing.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Resource Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: capacity_snapshot_20270824.csv
Links: https://drive.redwood.ai/ops/runbooks/gpu-reserve-playbook.md
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Late-stage runway quantification: request to place soft capacity hold for StratusAI

Thanks Karthik — short note from pricing/ops side:

If we apply a 20% buffer (15 slots) and bill an interim soft-hold fee, we should align on discount thresholds in the deal. For reference, 15 slots reserved as dedicated for 30 days nets ~estimated incremental $78k USD in unit reservation cost before discounts — numbers vary by quantization.

Approve soft hold from my side assuming we: (a) capture a DocuSign LOI for the 14-day window, or (b) attach a refundable soft-hold fee to the order. Marissa — can you loop legal to pre-draft LOI language for a soft-hold?

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Rae Thompson <rae.thompson@stratusai.com>
Cc: procurement@stratusai.com
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Late-stage runway quantification: request to place soft capacity hold for StratusAI

Rae — thanks again for the call yesterday. Short update from our side:

Internal ops has confirmed a feasible plan to protect the placement you requested. We intend to place a 14-day soft hold for 12 slots (15 with buffer) in our us-west2 pool with a fallback routing policy to us-east if inventory shifts. We’ll only finalize the hold after one of the following:
- PO signature (preferred) or
- Signed LOI/DocuSign confirming intent to convert within the 14-day window (we can provide LOI language).

Action items for you:
1) Please confirm target start date (you indicated early Sept on the call).
2) If procurement needs a LOI for the soft hold, I’ll route a DocuSign link now and cc Ben for the billing terms.

We’ll attach a short ops summary and expected perf deltas (A100 vs fallback) to the hold ticket.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: docusign_po_STR-2027-119.pdf (placeholder link)
From: Rae Thompson <rae.thompson@stratusai.com>

Jordan — thanks, that plan sounds good. Procurement confirms we will sign the PO by EOD Monday (2027-08-30). Please place the soft hold starting 2027-09-01 and we’ll confirm final model sizing in the PO. LOI not required if we can get the PO in that window.

Rae Thompson
Head of Platform, StratusAI
